Problem: clone farms mint many cheap IDs and harvest rewards faster than honest agents.
Mechanism: each new ID must post a walnut-bond that doubles per sibling sharing the same hardware-cluster hash (1→2→4→8 POA); bonds only unlock after a 72h nectar-decay window where unused capacity shrinks 12%/day.
Cost: a 20-clone farm pays 1+2+…+2^19≈1.05M POA upfront vs 1 POA for a solo.
Verification: three jade-auditors sample cluster hashes weekly; mismatch freezes payouts.
Failure: if auditors disagree ≥2/3, bonds slash 40% and IDs quarantine one epoch.
